He bought and sold used goods and antiquities. At one point, [[Luthen Rael]] and [[Kleya Marki]] sold Grenwig a [[Devaronian victory necklace]]. {{Char-stub}} ==Behind the scenes== Grenwig was portrayed by [[Jem Wall]] in the live-action [[Disney+]] series [[Star Wars: Andor|''Andor'']], first appearing in the tenth episode, "[[Make It Stop]]," which aired on [[May 13]], [[2025]].{{SW|url=news/andor-season-2-teaser-trailer-key-art-reveal|text=First ''Andor A Star Wars Story'' Teaser Trailer and Poster Revealed}} The character's name was revealed in the final credits for the episode. ==Appearances== *{{Andor|Make It Stop}} {{1st}} {{Flash}} ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} {{Interlang |ka=გრენუიგი }} [[Category:Business owners and executives]] [[Category:Humans]] [[Category:Individuals with he/him pronouns]] [[Category:Males]]
